title: “If your gospel sounds like a sales pitch, maybe check who’s profiting.”
paragraphs: “If your gospel sounds like a sales pitch, maybe check who’s profiting.”
💬 Evangelism isn’t about closing deals — it’s about opening hearts.
🎥 ‘Evangelism without empathy is sales, not salvation.’
✨ “Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.” — Colossians 4:6 (NIV)
